checks.note: Manifest, prompts, policy and tools are tracked in the repo and loaded from local paths, but no CODEOWNERS or ruleset is in the repo. Required review would be set in the hosting service, so it can't be checked here.

The release job builds, pushes and signs the production image on every push to main. It has no environment: key, so no protected environment or named-role approval gates it. The repo has no CODEOWNERS or IAM file naming who may change production config.

checks.quote: log.error("running state differs from release manifest: %s", ", ".join(mismatches))
checks.note: No emergency or break-glass path exists in the repo, and nothing records an owner, reason, end date or follow-up review. The procedure may live outside the repo. Startup only logs drift and continues.

violates: Show who is allowed to change production config
